name: a workout proposal diffs the whole plan against the plan as it stands and guards it
a swap reads as the movement removed and the movement added
a reorder of movements keeps every line in the proposed order
the plan as it stands makes no proposal
changing a movement with a logged set is refused plan-logged
leaving out a movement with a logged set is refused plan-logged
a movement the account cannot name is refused unknown-exercise
a second entry of a movement is a duplicate
a target beyond a hundred reps is refused on its change line
a finished workout is refused session-finished
a missing workout is gone
a workout started with no plan takes no proposal

ApplyWorkoutProposal refuses a pending proposal of a finished workout as workout-finished

DismissWorkoutProposal refuses a replaced proposal
